description: This file defines the ADODB2_access class, which extends ADODB_DataDict, providing data dictionary functionalities specific to the Microsoft Access database within the ADOdb PHP library. It includes methods for type conversion, schema modifications, and database operations tailored for Access.

classes.name: ADODB2_access
classes.description: A data dictionary class for Microsoft Access databases, extending the generic ADODB_DataDict class with Access-specific implementations.

methods.name: ActualType
methods.description: Converts metadata types to actual database types, supporting custom types and standard Access data types.

methods.name: _createSuffix
methods.description: Generates SQL suffixes for column definitions, considering auto-increment, nullability, defaults, and constraints.

methods.name: CreateDatabase
methods.description: Stub method for creating a database, currently returns an empty array.

methods.name: SetSchema
methods.description: Stub method for setting the database schema; no implementation specific to Access.

methods.name: AlterColumnSQL
methods.description: Stub for generating SQL to alter columns; not supported in Access, simply returns an array.

methods.name: DropColumnSQL
methods.description: Stub for generating SQL to drop columns; not supported in Access, simply returns an array.
